statement: An accepted call partial's validity is decoupled from execution-lease expiry: partials carry slot generations so a partial accepted within its slot generation remains valid for reduce even after the execution lease lapses, while a regenerated slot invalidates only its own stale partials — so raising a caller's deadlineMs beyond the lease window can never make honestly-accepted partials expire mid-invocation, and the call-partial-validity-slot-generations scenario is green.

constraints.statement: Slot generations extend the existing coordination row grammar; no parallel validity registry, timestamp side-channel, or second lease domain is introduced.
